verdict.rationale: Call analytics per number and per teammate is a fair question for a cloud phone and contact center product like Dialpad, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of reports showing call volume, answer rate, or missed calls by number or by user. Live coaching (Listen In/Barge In), AI CSAT scoring and the developer APIs are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate
